panels.title: Overview
panels.description: Collection and Coverage apply to the whole Bob source. Complete means collection finished without source errors, skipped records, invalid values, unsafe subtask reconciliation or unknown tool outcomes. Token fields omitted by Bob do not make coverage Partial. Chats and Chats with token counts use the same Project, Chat and time range; the latter requires recorded input and output, including zero. Recorded tokens sums known chat totals only; compare the two chat counts to see how many contribute. See Chats for missing-token reasons. Cached table values remain subject to Collection and Scan age. Tokens: K = thousand, Mil = million, Bil = billion.

panels.title: Input tokens
panels.description: Saved history and captured generation counts are separate series for the selected Project/Chat; never added together. Saved values require a saved message in the selected range. Captured values are cumulative ledger counts within the capture epoch, shown over Prometheus scrape history, not tokens spent within the range. Capture is always partial and excludes uncaptured calls, summaries, auxiliary calls, compaction and missing usage. Missing saved fields do not hide available captured values. Disabled, unavailable or stale capture leaves gaps; recorded zero remains zero. Tokens: K = thousand, Mil = million, Bil = billion.

panels.title: Tool activity
panels.description: Recorded history for chats with a saved message in the selected range. Project and Chat filter these values. Counts are saved tool results, not tool requests or shell exit codes. Unknown outcomes make the totals partial. Duration covers results with duration metadata. Bars share an automatic count scale; lengths are not percentages. Errors and unknown outcomes are subsets of Results, not separate slices of a total.

panels.title: Chats
panels.description: Saved tokens are database history for the selected chats. Token counts: Recorded means valid input/output; Not recorded by Bob means an absent saved field; Unavailable means invalid usage, unsafe subtask subtraction or an older collector. Unavailable / stale takes precedence when collection fails. Missing numeric cells show explicit text. File collection coverage is separate from token availability. Captured tokens are generation-only ledger totals, independent of saved totals. Capture is always partial: auxiliary calls, compaction, missing generation fields and uncaptured history are excluded. Recorded zero, missing, disabled and stale capture have separate states. https://turbra.github.io/traceonaut/dashboards/ibm-bob-beta/#read-the-values

panels.title: Captured generation tokens · partial
panels.description: Optional Bob 2.0.5 generation capture. Project/Chat filters apply. Ledger totals are cumulative within the capture epoch and do not follow the selected time range; interval tokens use Prometheus increase over scrape/commit time and are approximate. Saved history is separate. Excludes auxiliary calls, summaries, compaction and missing usage. Receiver health never proves Complete. Zero means explicitly recorded zero; unavailable samples stay unknown.
